title: Head of Series Quality
text:
Modern wire harness systems and exclusive vehicle interiors: The name DRÄXLMAIER stands for automotive innovations – products that enhance your driving experience. Every day, approximately 60,000 associates around the world cooperate to contribute their knowledge, skills and automotive passion toward this goal. Individuals, who like to take on responsibilities, use their creativity and contribute their ideas toward the common success. Individuals like you!

**Head of Series Quality**
==========================

Job Req ID: 139101

Location:
Duncan, US, 29334

Work Type: Full time

Contract Type: unlimited

**Objective of job:**

* Accountable for the development and maintenance of plant quality operations processes, as well as the strategic oversight and management of direct reports.
 

**Principal activities:**

**Strategic Planning & Implementation:**

* Develops long-term strategy for Plant Series Quality department and ensures implementation. Coordinates budget and headcount planning based on strategic goals.

**Leadership & Expertise:**

* Provides technical and disciplinary leadership to Series Quality Operations associates. Acts as subject matter expert on Quality Systems and processes.

**Guidelines & Processes:**

* Implements and communicates guidelines, processes, and systems for Plant Series Quality department.

**Quality Training:**

* Develops and maintains Quality Training program, ensuring employees understand and utilize fundamental quality concepts, best practices, and tools.

**Quality Best Practices:**

* Customizes quality best practices/tools to fit Plant organization needs.

**Culture of Quality:**

* Promotes a culture of quality and continuous improvement through structured use of quality tools and problem-solving methodologies.

**QMS Administration:**

* Administers Plant QMS processes, ensuring product and process conformance. Monitors quality control processes and ensures proper execution.

**Audit Support:**

* Leads Quality Operations in preparation for audits, maintains certifications, and drives corrective/preventative actions for audit findings.

**KPI Tracking:**

* Develops, tracks, and reports relevant KPIs in cooperation with Plant and Corporate functions.

**Team Management:**

* Leads, coaches, supervises, and motivates direct reports. Manages day-to-day activities of Series Quality Operations team.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identifies opportunities for process/product improvements and participates in corrective actions.
 

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 6 to 8 years experience with a complex manufacturing facility.
* 3 to 5 years of Automotive experience (interiors preferred).
* 3 to 5 years of Leadership desired.
 

We are looking forward to your application.

 

Company / Legal Entity: DAA Dräxlmaier Automotive of America LLC., Org-Code: O-AM2-DUN52

**Nearest Major Market:** Spartanburg
 
**Nearest Secondary Market:** South Carolina
